title: Umphefumlo Ongabizwanga Ngagama Owamelana Nesizwe Esingalunganga
intro: Kwiphepha leQuran, kukho abantu abamagama abo afihliweyo ukuze sicinge ngezifundo zabo. Omnye umntu onjalo wazalwa phakathi kwesizwe esasingabamkeli abathunywa baso, kodwa lo mntu wayenokholo olufihlakeleyo olwalubahlula. Xa intshabalalo yayisondela, lo mntu wema ngokuqinileyo kwinkolelo yakhe eyimfihlo. Ungamtyhila na lo mntu ungaqondakaliyo olumkisa abantu bakhe ngaphambi kokuba umyalelo wokugqibela ufike?
clues: Ndandihlala phakathi kwabantu ababesoloko bephika abathunywa ababethunyelwe kubo ngu-Allah.
Ngokungafaniyo nesizwe sam, ndayiqonda inyaniso xa kufika umthunywa onemiqondiso ecacileyo evela eNkosini yam.
Ndazifihla ukholo lwam kubacinezeli bam, ndisazi ukuba baza kundenzakalisa ukuba bafumanisa ukuba ndiyakholelwa.
Xa umyalelo wesohlwayo wawusondela, ndavakalisa ukunyaniseka kwam ngokuphandle ndaza ndalumkisa abantu bam ukuba bazisindise.
Ndibakhumbuze ukuba ndingumthunywa othembekileyo, ongahlukanga kwabo bathunyelwe ngaphambili, kwaye akufuneki banqule ngaphandle kuka-Allah.
Abantu bakuthi bandityhola ngokuba ndingumlingo nokuba ndiphambene, kodwa isohlwayo ababelunyukisiwe ngaso safika kubo ekugqibeleni.
